name: process
doc: Lifecycle of the one guest process a runtime holds (src/runtime). Empty: nothing loaded. Loading: files are being parsed, mapped and relocated. Ready: the main thread exists and has not run. Running: the run loop gives guest threads their slices. Paused: the run loop returned at a slice boundary and every thread keeps its saved context. Stopped is final and carries why: bits 32..39 the kind (1 exit, 2 break, 3 fault) and bits 0..31 the exit code (exit, break) or the fault kind (fault; src/runtime/index.ts FAULT_*). A file the loader refuses stops the process from Loading with a fault.

Stopped.name: why
Stopped.type: kind << 32 | exit code or fault kind
